paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Meshullam: Terumot, chapter 4, concerning Rabbi Eliezer’s and Rabbi Yehoshua’s words. Maimonides writes that he is mentioned only in Terumot 4:7, but he is also mentioned in Bekhorot 3:3, 24b, and chapter 6, 37a. It appears he was very old; in Ellu Terefot he disputes about the skull with Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar, Rabbi Meir’s student. He testified to a law in his brother Yonatan’s name—the text before us has Yochanan—who spoke in Rabbi Elazar Chisma’s name: end of HaNizakin 62a. Tosefta, Demai, chapter 2, alternatively chapter 3: Rabbi Natan his brother. They called him ‘the holy congregation’; see that entry, and ‘a holy assembly’ together with Rabbi Shimon ben Menasya; see his entry. Kohelet Rabbah, on ‘See life with a woman.’ He disputes with Rabbi Chanina ben Chakhinai: Menachot 62a. And Abba Yose ben Dosai.
